name: Kanashige Otoha
source: The class president who is a serious and straight-laced person. Otoha isn't involved in the hypnotism business, but she has noticed her classmates acting weird lately, so she decides to ask the [url=/c82146]protagonist[/url] for help. Her weakness is being spanked.
